errata_records.remediation: Retired EXP-UL-B4_FUTURE placeholder. Deltoid, Trapezius, Pectoralis Major, Pectoralis Minor, Latissimus Dorsi, and Serratus Anterior reclassified under neutral OWNER_UNASSIGNED_FUTURE_UPPER_LIMB.
errata_records.justification: B4 is canonically reserved for Brachium / Cubital Fossa. Assigning shoulder-supporting girdle muscles to B4 violated batch scope boundaries.
